observations: The red-suite criterion is intentionally historical: red-suite.txt is captured before features 086/087 repair production behavior, so later green runs do not erase the proof that each regression discriminated against the v0.9.0 implementation.

The eleven schema negatives are paired with existing valid fixtures in the same C12 families. The compare probe adds its own resolved-to-open input and asserts membership in reopened plus absence from persisting/stale, preventing a bare-exit-code or empty-output false pass.

The matrix splits grouped GitHub bullets into 30 atomic rows, so independent subclaims such as the two consumer-copy wording defects and the three circuit-breaker defects cannot be closed as a bundle without individual targets.

The no-production-change command anchors to main revision 98e043e and explicitly covers every schema, compare source, methodology/ecosystem/standard tree, skill index, and tools README named by issue #52; planning, contracts, fixtures, harness registration, and evidence are the only intended changes.

final_verdict.summary: APPROVED at revision 0. The contract is bounded to the red TDD step, covers all 30 atomic issue #52 findings, names eleven schema regressions plus one compare-behavior regression, requires exact named failure evidence with the real exit code, guards existing positive polarity, and forbids production remediation. The checks are discriminating and non-vacuous; implementation may proceed.
